none: PAS LON-E871D7: Roman copper alloy coin: commemorative radiate of Constantinopolis
contea di ritrovamento: Greater London (Inghilterra e Galles)

Roman copper alloy commemorative nummus of Constantinopolis, issued by the House of Constantine (AD 317-364), struck at Lugdunum (Lyons) AD 330-340. Reece Period 17. Obverse: Helmeted bust of Constantinopolis left, wearing imperial mantle and holding sceptre. Obverse inscription: [CONS]TANTINOP[OLIS]. Reverse: Victory left on prow with sceptre and shield, symbol of Constantinople, New Rome.…
